precision_review.mechanism: Alignment uses 2^(eta-13); after a carry the source normalized grid is coarser. FP32 can retain the bit lost by source13.
precision_review.evidence_limit: Archive endpoint agreement supports the source candidate on these rows, not a universal paper/source or physical-device conformance theorem.
precision_review.paper_probe_caveat: Section 4.1.4 states p1=1 but its stopping expression is 1+p1+p2; tests use the explicit numerical endpoint 1+2^-12, without silently repairing that expression.
